revision: 1 (PDR draft, WP-PDR-27, TS-011 revision 1; AT RISK CR-003 and CR-006)
status: Draft planning data for WP-PDR-37 (floorplan, KiCad outline) and WP-PDR-39 (cwht-case-c.scad, cwht-case-cnc.scad). Values are the TS-011 and TS-004 author's proposals; they change only through the WP-PDR-27 author until the TS-011 decision, then by the ADR that records it.
sources: docs/icd/ICD-PWR-CELL.md 3.2.2 (Keystone 1043P 77 x 20.65 x 14.86 mm, pair about 41.3 x 77 mm)
docs/icd/ICD-CTL-USB.md 3.2.2 (wall opening 12.0 x 10.0 mm, opening centre about 2.3 mm above the carrier PCB)
docs/icd/ICD-TX-ANT.md 3.2.2 (SMA bulkhead jack, HEX 8 nut, counterpoise within 20 mm)
frame: Enclosure frame: origin at the outer corner of the back face at the key-jack end; +X along the length toward the antenna end (REQ-SYS-175: antenna port on the +X end face), +Y across the width, +Z from the back face (cell door and heatsink guard) to the front face (display and knobs). Board frame: origin at the board's lower-left corner seen from the top side, axes parallel to the enclosure frame.

envelope.requirement: REQ-SYS-103: 140 x 70 x 40 mm (TBR), excluding antenna and knobs
envelope.note: The CNC fallback (option A) uses the same outer 140 x 70 x 30 mm, the same board frame and the same end-face openings; its pedestal replaces the heatsink (TS-011 section 8).

z_stack.layer: back wall (the heatsink guard frame protrudes up to 10 mm beyond it, within REQ-SYS-103)
holder zone (Keystone 1043P 14.86 mm on the board bottom, plus 1.04 mm clearance)
top-side part zone (tallest top part 8.5 mm plus 0.6 mm clearance)

board.panelization: single board with two 5 mm tab-routed rails on the long edges, removed by the owner (TS-004 recommendation)

mounting.fastener: M3 x 6 pan head from the top side into brass heat-set inserts in back-shell bosses (option C) or tapped 6061 bosses (CNC fallback)

support_posts.rule: one printed post under each front-panel button (positions set by WP-PDR-37 with WP-PDR-39 at the button locations); bottom-side copper-free contact pad 6 mm diameter
support_posts.basis: TS-004 section 4 stiffness (tolerance_stack.py L3): a 1.0 mm board deflects 3.17 mm under 10 N at the middle of a 120 mm span and 0.76 mm across the 74.5 mm span of the six-boss layout; the posts bring the button deflection under 0.3 mm

mounting.boss_gussets: four 1.5 mm gussets from each boss to the back wall (TS-011 revision 1 rule 20; drop row D15)

front_shell_posts.rule: TS-011 revision 1 rule 18 (drop rows D7, D8, D10): printed front-shell posts, 6 mm diameter, bear on 6 mm copper-free pads on the board top
front_shell_posts.note: the first two are within 10 mm of the PA pad edge; the other four are over the holder bodies (the button support posts count if WP-PDR-37 places the buttons there). These posts touch the board where it runs hot; they pass M8 only with the rule 15 filament

keepouts_bottom.name: cell holder pair (Keystone 1043P x 2, through-hole, owner-soldered)
heatsink footprint (no bottom-side parts, no through-hole pins protruding more than 0.5 mm)
PA thermal pad: mask-free ENIG copper 15 x 15 mm, fed by the 25-via array (pcbway-export-and-vendor-questions.md F16, F18)

keepouts_top.name: port block overhang and SMA pigtail landing
front-shell post pads (rule 18): copper-free, no parts
PA thermal sensors NTC-1 and NTC-2 (rule 14)

heatsink.type: purchased extruded aluminum heatsink, black anodized, fins parallel to X, fin tips toward -Z (outward through the back)
heatsink.in_situ_basis: 6.11 K/W is the REQ-SYS-112 pass threshold of TS-011 M4 (45 C, 4.1 W, iteration 1 chain 9.74 K/W below the heat sink); the catalog value comes from the guard model of board_field_thermal.py at a convection fraction of 0.8 (3.83 at 0.7, 4.71 at 0.9, Low). The in-situ value is measured on the printed guard coupon before the case is committed (TS-011 section 8 rule 3)
heatsink.note: The base sits on the gap pad under the board; the fins pass through an opening in the back wall and end at least 2.5 mm behind a printed guard 2.0 mm thick carried on a raised frame, so the heatsink and guard use up to 10 mm of the REQ-SYS-103 Z allowance beyond the 30 mm case (40 mm total). The in-situ value includes the guard; the catalog free-air rating must be lower (TS-011 revision 1 section 8 rule 3). A front-face drop drives the heat sink toward the board: two front-shell posts over the PA region carry it (rule 18).

port_block.type: 6061 block, PCBWay CNC, ordered with the board at CDR (TS-011 C1); D-hole for the SMA bulkhead thread (anti-rotation), M3 counterpoise hole within 20 mm of the port axis, two M3 clearance holes to heat-set inserts in the end-wall boss
port_block.pcb_connection: RG-316 pigtail about 35 mm long from the jack to board pads (owner-soldered, SI-031), compliant, so the port block tolerance does not load a board joint (mechanical-tolerance-stack.md stack S1)
port_block.inner_flange_basis: TS-011 revision 1 rule 6: the flange bears on the pocket in an end-on +X drop (drop rows D18, D19)

plus_x.feature: SMA bulkhead jack through the port block

minus_x.feature: key jack opening, diameter 9.0 (planning); nose face 1.0 mm behind the outer face (rule 21); coated collar 6 mm deep behind the wall (shielding rule O2)
headphone jack opening, diameter 9.0 (planning); nose face 1.0 mm behind the outer face (rule 21); coated collar 6 mm deep behind the wall (shielding rule O2)

micro-USB opening 12.6 x 10.6 (proposed change from ICD-CTL-USB 12.0 x 10.0, stack S5), continued by a coated shroud of the same section to the receptacle face plane, closed there by a flange cut to the receptacle shell and bonded to it by a conductive gasket (shielding rule O1)
jack markings KEY and PHONES, 3.5 mm characters, debossed 0.6 mm with contrasting inlay, above each opening

faces.back: cell door over the holder zone (x 6 to 83), heatsink guard grille over the heatsink (x 87 to 128) with slots 6.0 mm wide, legend-free
faces.front: display window, two encoders, two buttons: positions set by WP-PDR-39 and WP-PDR-40 inside x 10 to 125
faces.side_y0: RF exposure legend (REQ-SYS-124), three lines of 3.5 mm characters, debossed 0.6 mm with contrasting inlay, in x 15 to 115, z 8 to 24

accessible_surface_set_preliminary.finger: straight test finger, 12 mm diameter, hemispherical tip, 80 mm reach (REQ-SYS-113 TBR, proposed in TS-011 section 8)
accessible: every outer face of the front and back shells
the heatsink guard grille (outer face and slot walls to 0.8 mm depth)
the knobs and the front face around them
the SMA jack body beyond the nut and the nut
the jack and USB openings to the depth the finger reaches
not_accessible: heatsink fins and base (behind the guard, tips recessed at least 2.5 mm behind a guard whose 6.0 mm slots admit the finger 0.80 mm)
the port block except its end face around the nut
accessible_surface_set_preliminary.status: Preliminary, by design rule. The scripted finger check on the assembly model (WP-PDR-39 model, TC-SYS-077 procedure, TV record per CR-003 R3-F3) generates the set that WP-PDR-28b uses.

thermal_sensors.rule: TS-011 revision 1 section 8 rule 14 (INSP-087 finding-1): both PA thermal sensors sit on the board, on the top-side copper of the PA thermal pad, within 2 mm of the PA device's edge; none sits on the heat sink or on any removable part, so no sensor wire crosses to the heat sink, and a lifted heat sink or gap pad raises both readings with the junction

sensors.function: REQ-SYS-118 firmware thermistor (HZ-003 K2), read by the SW-SAFE thermal unit
REQ-SYS-181 firmware-independent cut-off sensor (HZ-003 K9: 'a second NTC at the PA'), feeding the comparator that removes the PA-path enable

thermal_sensors.trip_relation: junction to sensor is RthJC 3.0 K/W: at 4.1 W the 95 C +/-3 C cut-off acts at a junction of 104.3 to 110.3 C in every option (107.3 C nominal); a heat-sink sensor would act at 131.9 to 143.0 C (board_field_thermal.py item 3)
thermal_sensors.routing: board traces only; NTC-2 and its comparator are routed apart from the NTC-1 ADC path (independence of K9 from firmware, 07 section 14.1)

case_filament.rule: TS-011 revision 1 rule 15 (INSP-081 finding-2): heat-deflection temperature at 0.45 MPa at least 99 C, which a PC-class filament meets (recalled typical values, Low; the owner fetches the TDS); PETG (69 C) fails M8 at the bosses and the board-facing walls at the REQ-SYS-112 condition
case_filament.status: needs a CON-015 change (an L0 constraint, CR-003 observation on the PETG wording); owner decision at B1b
